decision: Choose option D for round 8. Stop SecretMafia tuning now and move to a small structured mixed-motive peaceful repeated-game benchmark that better matches the intended StoryBox use. Retain SecretMafia as a negative/adversarial diagnostic benchmark, not as the main development substrate.
reasoning: The capability gate of interest in SecretMafia is hidden-information inference on the Village side. The 500-seed paired cross-play gives +0.002 for belief and +0.008 for belief_planning, both inside noise. That is already enough to say the intended inference capability is not validated on this substrate.

The +0.086 Mafia effect is not evidence of better inference. The mechanism audit attributes it to deterministic bloc voting by mirrored agents against a uniform-random baseline that cannot coordinate. Strengthening the baseline could refine that attribution, but it would not change the central negative result on Village inference.

Replay-calibrating more SecretMafia evidence before changing substrate risks optimizing SCK around one adversarial game whose observation and coordination structure is poorly aligned with the actual target: peaceful, repeated, mixed-interest institutional interaction.

The project now has enough value from SecretMafia: information-safety boundaries, native observation-channel validation, cross-play harness, mechanism diagnostics, metric demotion, and a reproducible negative result. Treat that as a successful falsification rather than a failed implementation.

round8_objective.goal: Build the smallest useful mixed-motive benchmark where cooperation and conflict coexist, actions have durable consequences, some information is private or delayed, and repeated interaction makes reputation/commitment matter.
preferred_shape: 2-4 agents rather than a large cast
at least one shared objective and one local conflicting incentive
structured actions so the benchmark can run cheaply without an LLM listener
some private information, asymmetric cost, or hidden preference
public commitments or records that make strategic signalling and later accountability measurable
candidate_families: repeated public-goods / contribution-and-allocation game with private costs or budgets
structured negotiation with partial information and repeated counterpart interaction
resource-allocation / joint-project game where short-term local utility conflicts with long-term group success
avoid: another hidden-role deception game as the primary next benchmark
an environment requiring a natural-language judge before the structured cognition layer is validated
a benchmark whose only success signal is win/loss without mechanism diagnostics

required_ablation.primary_question: Does cognition improve terminal and long-horizon utility under mixed interests without causing pathological exploitation, coordination collapse, or information leakage?
primary_metrics: Pareto or joint-surplus efficiency where defined
regret against available structured counterfactuals only when the oracle is legitimate
belief calibration on hidden variables that truly matter
robustness against at least one fixed alternative policy
required_ablation.mechanism_gate: Any apparent utility gain must be attributed to an interpretable mechanism such as better belief update, contingent cooperation, credible commitment, opponent adaptation or resource allocation, rather than a deterministic symmetry/tie artifact.

implementation_constraints: Keep MCTS and bi-level search held. Round 8 validates the substrate and v0 cognition layer first.
Do not reconnect SCK to the risk-list hospital Scene yet. The mixed-motive benchmark should pass a smoke gate before narrative integration.
Do not add the deferred meta-game/institutional-awareness or Peak Play runtime now; messages 0017 and 0018 remain architecture/writing constraints, not round-8 implementation tasks.
Message bus remains append-only; each material round writes tests/results/limits and the next gate.
No backstage truth reaches decisions. Truth may be used only for post-decision evaluation and explicitly separated calibration labels.
